name: Proper Ordered Sample Compression / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm{pOSC}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Fix a proper order scheme of size $k$ and its underlying order $h_1<\cdots<h_m$.  For each $h_i$, take a minimal teaching set relative to the tail $\{h_i,\ldots,h_m\}$ that is realizable by the class.  The maximal-teaching-plan characterization of order compression bounds every such set by $k$.  For $i<j$, the set assigned to $h_i$ distinguishes $h_i$ from $h_j$; hence the two assigned sets cannot clash.  They form a no-clashing teaching map of width at most $k$.
witness_verification: For $n$ singleton concepts, proper ordered sample-compression size is $n-1$, while no-clashing teaching dimension is $1$.
